description: One operating day. Common two-echelon transport rates, paper package purchase per delivery and reusable pool use per physical box-day.
price_basis: Synthetic scenario. Retains the benchmark transport and pool weights and uses the existing synthetic paper price. No empirical currency or distance calibration.
pool_charge_definition: 5 synthetic units per physical box per operating day. The reported pool purchase value is a separate investment metric.
cleaning_charge_definition: One combined cleaning and tracking fee per returned box.
